name: Answer questions with a code interpreter agent that runs Python in Daytona
description: An AI agent that answers questions needing exact calculations by writing Python and running it in an isolated Daytona sandbox. Each tool call gets a fresh sandbox that is deleted after the run.
shortDescription: Give an AI agent a code interpreter that runs Python in an isolated Daytona sandbox.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the Daytona Execute Code tool as a code interpreter
The model writes the code; the tool runs it in an isolated, temporary Daytona sandbox
Exact answers for calculations, counting, hashing and data processing instead of guesses
The agent reads errors, fixes its code and runs it again
prerequisites: Daytona account and API key with the write:sandboxes and delete:sandboxes permissions
idealFor: Teams that want an AI agent to answer questions that need exact calculations or code, without running AI-generated code on their own servers.
steps: Trigger: run the workflow manually with a question in the Question input.
The AI agent writes a Python program that answers the question.
The Run Python in Daytona tool runs the program in a new Daytona sandbox, returns the printed output and deletes the sandbox.
The agent answers from the output and explains how it computed the result.
